comparison.driver:
import importlib.util,json,statistics,sys,shutil
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from validation_support import command,clean_environment,save_json,sha
from logue_oracle import expected
root=Path.cwd(); base=Path('/tmp/birnam-logue-logfix');binary=Path('/tmp/birnam-range-handlers/prefix-v2/bin/birnam')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('old_oracle',base/'baseline-oracle.py');old=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(old)
runs=[]
for v in ['baseline','candidate']:
    work=base/('pair-'+v);work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(base/'baseline-core.birnam' if v=='baseline' else root/'examples/logue/logue-core.birnam',work/'logue-core.birnam')
    shutil.copy2(root/'examples/logue/logue-bench.birnam',work/'logue-bench.birnam')
for serial,v in enumerate(['baseline','candidate','candidate','baseline']):
    work=base/('pair-'+v)
    for phase,n in [('crowded',8),('quiet',0)]:
        cfg=dict(phase='arena',seed=12345,width=16,monsters=n,turns=16,batches=4,samples=3,allocation=False,replace=False)
        fields=' '.join('#'+k+' -> '+json.dumps(x) for k,x in cfg.items())
        (work/'run.birnam').write_text('[Globals at: #LogueBenchConfig put: {'+fields+'}];\n[System load: "logue-bench.birnam"]')
        row=command([binary,'run.birnam'],cwd=work,env=clean_environment(),timeout=180)
        assert row['exit_code']==0 and not row['stderr'],row
        lines=row['stdout'].splitlines();assert len(lines)==2 and lines[0]=='[logue-core] loaded',lines
        report=json.loads(lines[1]);states,_=(old.expected if v=='baseline' else expected)(cfg)
        for sample,want in zip(report['results'],states):
            assert len(sample)==len(want)
            for b,s in zip(sample,want):assert json.loads(b['state_json'])==s,(v,phase,b)
        assert len(report['results'])==3
        rows=[b for sample in report['results'] for b in sample]
        runs.append(dict(variant=v,phase=phase,serial=serial,source_sha256=sha(work/'logue-core.birnam'),samples=rows,checked=True))
        print(v,phase,round(statistics.median(b['cpu_ns'] for b in rows)/1e6,3),flush=True)
        save_json(base/'pair-results.json',dict(binary_sha256=sha(binary),harness_sha256=sha(work/'logue-bench.birnam'),runs=runs,driver=Path(__file__).read_text()))
summary={}
for phase in ['crowded','quiet']:
    summary[phase]={}
    for batch in ['all',1,2,3,4]:
        vals={v:statistics.median(b['cpu_ns'] for r in runs if r['phase']==phase and r['variant']==v for b in r['samples'] if batch=='all' or b['batch']==batch) for v in ['baseline','candidate']}
        summary[phase][str(batch)]={**vals,'reduction_percent':100*(1-vals['candidate']/vals['baseline'])}
result=json.loads((base/'pair-results.json').read_text());result['summary']=summary
save_json(base/'pair-results.json',result);print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

delivery: Working tree only; no installation, commit or push.
interpretation: The paired comparison uses the same harness/runtime in ABBA order, two fresh processes per variant/case, three samples and four consecutive batches per process. Different oracles deliberately admit only the intended bounded-log change. Timings are recorded without source instrumentation. Quiet is the control. The source census is not an Id send census or a CPU attribution.

import json,os,select,signal,subprocess,sys,time,shutil
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from validation_support import clean_environment,sha,save_json
from logue_oracle import Arena,wire
base=Path('/tmp/birnam-logue-logfix/profile');base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
binary='/tmp/birnam-range-handlers/prefix-v2/bin/birnam'
core=Path('examples/logue/logue-core.birnam');shutil.copy2(core,base/core.name)
harness=Path('examples/logue/logue-bench.birnam').read_text().split('// Warm once')[0]
source='[Globals at: #LogueBenchConfig put: {#phase -> "arena" #seed -> 12345 #width -> 16 #monsters -> 8 #turns -> 16 #allocation -> false}];\n'+harness+'''
[benchArena value]; [benchOperation value]; [benchArena value]; [System gc];
[System println: "ready"]; [System readLine];
[[1 to: 40] do: [:pass | [benchOperation value]]];
[System println: [Json stringify: [benchSnapshot value]]]
'''
(base/'sample.birnam').write_text(source)
p=subprocess.Popen([binary,'sample.birnam'],cwd=base,env=clean_environment(),stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
try:
    end=time.monotonic()+45; ready=b''
    while not ready.endswith(b'ready\n'):
        remaining=end-time.monotonic()
        if remaining<=0 or not select.select([p.stdout],[],[],remaining)[0]: raise TimeoutError('readiness')
        b=os.read(p.stdout.fileno(),4096)
        if not b: raise RuntimeError('exited before readiness: '+str(ready))
        ready+=b
    assert ready==b'[logue-core] loaded\nready\n',ready
    with (base/'sample.log').open('wb') as log:
        sampler=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/sample',str(p.pid),'5','1','-file',str(base/'sample.txt')],stdout=log,stderr=log)
        try:
            p.stdin.write(b'\n');p.stdin.flush()
            assert sampler.wait(timeout=20)==0
        finally:
            if sampler.poll() is None: sampler.kill();sampler.wait()
    out,err=p.communicate(timeout=90)
    assert p.returncode==0 and not err,(p.returncode,err)
    observed=json.loads(out);arena=Arena(12345,16,8)
    for _ in range(640):arena.step()
    assert observed==wire(arena.snapshot()),observed
    save_json(base/'result.json',dict(checked=True,turns=640,state=observed,source=source,source_sha256=sha(base/'sample.birnam'),core_sha256=sha(core),binary_sha256=sha(binary),sample_sha256=sha(base/'sample.txt'),sampler_seconds=5,sampler_interval_ms=1,driver=Path(__file__).read_text()))
    print('native sample complete; 640-turn state checked',flush=True)
finally:
    if p.poll() is None:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
    try:p.communicate(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.communicate()

Allocation mode disables automatic GC for one batch and is not a timing baseline. Live counters are process-wide and include retained harness output; charge is GC accounting, not RSS.
